steps.text_en: Inspect and repair fan F2 Check and repair fan F2 for vibration or knocking, then reassemble. Look at and move the parts to find looseness or misalignment. Correct it and reassemble. Fit all guards and Check my work. It runs for 3 seconds. Passed/ready means done.
Start Check F2 for loose or misaligned parts Start with the front guard, blade or rear guard. ✓ You need not check every part. Power is isolated. Leave the motor, base, pole and head alone.

Check Check the marks and clip, then try moving the guard rims Hold a guard rim with Grip, not the pole or motor head. ✓ The front sits flush with aligned marks and a closed clip. The rear rim does not wobble.
Open To reach the blade, remove the front guard Press Trigger once at the clip. Then hold the guard with Grip, turn it and pull it off. ✓ The blade is visible.
Check With the front off, look at the blade and cap The blade cap is the round part at the centre of the blade. ✓ Normal: groove fully on pin; cap tight.
Open To remove the blade, loosen its cap Hold the round cap with Trigger. Turn it clockwise when viewed from the front. ✓ Once unthreaded, remove and release.
Open With the cap off, hold the blade with Grip and pull it straight off ✓ Put it down. The rear ring face is visible.

Check Try moving the rear guard and check whether its ring is tight Hold the guard rim with Grip. The ring is the round part around the shaft. ✓ A secured guard does not wobble. Fitting the ring alone does not tighten it.

If the rear guard moves If rear is loose/misaligned, remove ring and realign Hold the ring with Trigger. From the front, turn counterclockwise to loosen and clockwise to tighten. ✓ Do not pull while threaded on. Tighten until rim stays still.
Reassemble Refit blade: groove on pin Hold the blade with Grip. Fit its groove over the pin and push fully in. ✓ The blade does not wobble.
Reassemble Tighten the blade cap Hold the cap with Trigger. Turn counterclockwise when viewed from the front. ✓ Release when tight.
Reassemble Refit the removed front guard Hold the guard with Grip. Align the marks, push and turn it into place. Press Trigger at the clip. ✓ Both guards on; clip closed.
Check my work Select Check my work on Main and listen A 3-second run: hear the symptom before repair or check afterwards. ✓ Passed/ready means done.
If not passed Read the result, correct and retry Missing guards: no test. Abnormal sound: still loose or misaligned. ✓ System fault: tell researcher. Not your fault.
